title: Request Access
intro_heading: Get Started with CUNY AI Lab Tools
intro_description: The CUNY AI Lab offers AI tools for faculty, staff, and students at every CUNY campus. Use this form to request access to the CAIL Sandbox, our secure, zero-retention interface for working with AI models, or to tools portal apps such as Agent Studio, Site Studio, and PDF Accessibility.
features: CAIL Sandbox with multiple AI models, plus in-Sandbox tools like AmigAI and course-specific assistants
Agent Studio for research workflows and Site Studio for building academic websites
Media and accessibility tools: transcription, alt-text, OCR, and PDF accessibility
Zero-retention API services for data privacy
Support from the CUNY AI Lab team

intended_use.label: Intended Use
intended_use.placeholder: Please describe how you plan to use the CAIL Sandbox and the CUNY AI Lab tools (e.g., course integration, research project, language learning, etc.)

privacy_note: Your information will only be used to process your access request and provide support. The CUNY AI Lab follows CUNY's privacy policies and uses zero-retention practices.
